chapter_seo_title: RMJI Ch. 267 – The State of the War: Han Li’s Puppet Breakthrough & the Six Sects Siege
chapter_meta_description: Han Li nears the first layer of the Great Derivative Art and builds his first Grade Two puppet as the war between the Seven Sects and the Six Demonic Sects grinds into a brutal stalemate. Then the enemy arrives.
og_title: A War of Attrition and a Fraying Stalemate – RMJI Ch. 267
og_description: Han Li’s cultivation accelerates as the conflict between the Seven Great Sects and the Six Demonic Sects escalates into a resource war. The calm at the spirit mine is about to break.
twitter_title: Han Li’s first Grade Two puppet is ready—just in time for the demonic path to arrive at the mine.
twitter_description: The war update reveals staggering losses (two-digit Core Formation deaths!), and Han Li quietly realizes his talent lies not in brute qi but in processing power. Then the alarm sounds.

lore_anchors.definition: A foundational mental cultivation technique from the Thousand Bamboo School; strengthens divine sense and enables the Soul Divide technique for controlling multiple puppets.
A puppet mechanism on par with a Foundation Establishment cultivator’s combat power; requires high-grade magic tool materials to refine.
The six major demonic-path schools of the Tian Luo Nation, a dominant power in the Tian Nan region.
The seven orthodox cultivation sects of Yue Country, arrayed against the Six Demonic Sects.
Originally a branch of the demonic path’s Imperial Spirit Sect, planted in Yue Country thousands of years ago as a sleeper agent.
A demonic-path sect specializing in spirit beasts and spirit insects; the parent organization of the Spirit Beast Mountain Sect.
The defensive formation protecting the spirit mine; a major positional asset in the current siege.
A cultivator who has consolidated their qi into a stable internal foundation; the second major realm of cultivation, granting greatly enhanced lifespan and power.
A cultivator who has formed a golden core (elixir) within their dantian; a strategic-level combatant whose life or death can shift the balance of a war.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does the Great Derivative Art come so easily to Han Li when everything else is a struggle?
cultural_notes_faq.a: His talent is not in raw qi manipulation but in mental processing—divine sense, calculation, and extreme situational awareness—which the Great Derivative Art demands.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why didn’t the Spirit Beast Mountain Sect stay loyal to the demonic path?
cultural_notes_faq.a: After thousands of years as a separate sect, its upper echelons no longer identified as part of the Imperial Spirit Sect and refused to accept a new “emperor” above them.

cultural_notes_faq.q: How long has the war been going on?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The chapter states dozens of battles have been fought, with over ten thousand casualties and eight Core Formation deaths, suggesting a protracted campaign of months.
